summary: LG Display Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its semi-annual report for the period January 1 to June 30, 2026, translated from Korean and prepared under K-IFRS. The filing is a routine periodic disclosure required by the Korean Financial Supervisory Commission and furnished to the SEC under Rule 13a-16. It contains standard operational, financial, and risk management information, with no announced special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review. This is a routine semi-annual report, not a special-situation event.
